import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    static long fastPow(long a, long p) {
        long res = 1;
        long powPart = a % MOD;
        long mask = 1;
        int bits = 64; // enough for long
        for (int i = 0; i < bits; i++) {
            if ((p & mask) != 0) {
                res = (res * powPart) % MOD;
            }
            mask <<= 1;
            powPart = (powPart * powPart) % MOD;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static boolean solve(Scanner sc, PrintWriter pw, boolean multipleTestMode) {
        if (!sc.hasNextLong()) {
            return false;
        }
        long p = sc.nextLong();
        long k = sc.nextLong();

        if (multipleTestMode && !sc.hasNextLong()) {
            return false;
        }

        if (k == 0) {
            long ans = fastPow(p, p - 1);
            pw.println(ans);
            return multipleTestMode;
        }

        if (k == 1) {
            long ans = fastPow(p, p);
            pw.println(ans);
            return multipleTestMode;
        }

        boolean[] used = new boolean[(int)p + 1]; // p is up to 10^6? but safe
        long ans = 1;
        long groups = 0;

        for (long x = 1; x < p; x++) {
            int idx = (int)x;
            if (used[idx]) continue;
            groups++;
            ans = (ans * p) % MOD;
            used[idx] = true;
            long v = x;
            while (true) {
                long next = (v * k) % p;
                int nextIdx = (int)next;
                if (used[nextIdx]) break;
                used[nextIdx] = true;
                v = next;
            }
        }

        pw.println(ans);
        return multipleTestMode;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        Scanner sc;
        if (args.length > 0) {
            sc = new Scanner(new File(args[0]));
        } else {
            sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        }
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        // In the original code, if ONLINE_JUDGE is defined, multipleTestMode is false.
        // Here we assume we are not in online judge, so we loop.
        // To match the original behavior, we can set a flag.
        boolean multipleTestMode = true; // as in non-ONLINE_JUDGE
        while (solve(sc, pw, multipleTestMode)) {
            // continue
        }
        pw.flush();
        pw.close();
        sc.close();
    }
}
